newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sanacorp says owns option for Anzag stake.
newsitem.headline: Sanacorp says owns option for Anzag stake.

text.p: Germany's Sanacorp e.G., the parent company of Sanacorp Pharmahandel AG, on Monday said it owned a call-option on 14 percent of the base capital of pharmaceuticals group Andreae-Noris Zahn AG (Anzag).

Sanacorp Chief Executive Juergen Brink told a news conference to announce the book building price range for Sanacorp Pharmahandel's public offering that the Anzag option contract had a three year duration.
Brink said Sanacorp, which already owns 25 percent minus one share of Anzag, wanted to co-operate with Anzag in the future if cartel regulations allowed.
The bookbuilding range for the roughly two million Sanacorp shares on offer was set at 30 ($19.62) to 35 marks. The bookbuilding ends on October 18.
